scene_handoff_received.location_and_situation: Núcleo Sistêmico Parte 33 (SLUS/TEXT/0403 a 0416: Fichas biográficas dos protagonistas, tutoriais completos de combate/sistema e verbetes enciclopédicos fundamentais de lore de Sol Ciel) concluído com soberania absoluta do texto japonês, eliminação de 21 estouros de buffer legados, erradicação de decalques (Cosmosfera em vez de Espaço da Alma) e aprovação 100% no Hard Gate.

active_hooks: Conclusão integral do bloco BLK_SYS_033 (IDs 29554 a 29835).
Fichas biográficas, tutoriais de sistema e enciclopédia de lore de Sol Ciel plenamente consolidados para os blocos subsequentes.

Ar tonelico.note: Preservar grafia e espaço; 'tonelico' em minúscula. Refere-se à Primeira Torre de Sol Ciel ('a Torre Ar tonelico' ou 'Ar tonelico').

Reyvateil.note: Donzelas cantoras capazes de sintonizar a Torre e converter canções em poder (Magia da Canção). Plural: Reyvateils.

Cosmosphere.note: O mundo interior e psicológico da Reyvateil dividido em níveis (Nível 1 a 9). Evitar 'cosmoesfera'.

Dive.note: Substantivo: 'Mergulho' (o ato de entrar na Cosmosfera). Verbo: 'mergulhar'. 'Dive Shop' -> Loja de Mergulho / Centro de Mergulho.

Song Magic.note: Poder conjurado pelas Reyvateils. A canção cresce em potência enquanto elas cantam (Harmonics/Burst).

Hymn Crystal.note: Cristais especiais gravados com canções de alta tecnologia (ex.: Purger, Phaizer, Chronicle Key).

Hymn Code.note: Código alfanumérico único registrado no servidor da Torre para cada Reyvateil de alta linhagem.

Grathnode.note: Condutor e cristal sonoro. Cristais Grathnode aprimoram atributos e efeitos das Reyvateils.

Grathnode Crystal.note: Plural: Cristais Grathnode. Cristais instalados na Reyvateil.

Grathmeld.note: A arte e método de síntese alquímica sonora do mundo de Sol Ciel.

Install.note: Ato de colocar Cristais Grathnode na Porta de Instalação da Reyvateil.

Installer Port.note: Conector biotecnológico na pele da Reyvateil (localizado na região lombar/abaixo das costas).

Harmonics.note: Nível de sintonia e ressonância emocional entre Lyner e a Reyvateil durante a batalha.

Blastline.note: A violenta barreira de plasma atmosférico que separa o Mundo Superior do Mundo Inferior.

Platina.note: A cidade flutuante no topo da Torre Ar tonelico, onde Lyner nasceu e os Cavaleiros residem.

Lower World.note: As terras e cidades flutuantes abaixo da Blastline (Karff, Tenba, Beco Vagalume, etc.).

Elemia Church.note: A instituição religiosa e protetora que venera a Deusa de Elemia e administra Reyvateils.

Tenba.note: A poderosa corporação industrial-militar do Mundo Inferior com ambições de expansão tecnológica.

Teru Tribe.note: Humanoides com orelhas pontudas e herança mágica/tecnológica ancestral que vivem no Mundo Inferior.

Firefly Alley.note: Distrito de compras e comércio no Mundo Inferior onde mora Hama.

Plasma Bell.note: Instalação vital no alto da Torre de Sol Ciel que sustenta a vida no continente flutuante e é vigiada por Kanade.

A.B.R..note: Guardião autônomo tripartite da Torre de Elemia composto pelos módulos α, β e γ (JP ABR).

ELMA-DS.note: Forma viral malévola e negra que corrompe e replica o guardião autônomo ELMA criado por Shurelia (JP ELMAーDS).

ELMA.note: Guardião original de base branca criado por Shurelia para proteger os santuários da Torre (JP エルマ / ELMA).

Ar Tonelicard.note: Coleção de cards especiais colecionáveis do jogo (JP アルトレカ). Séries 1 a Final e SP A a L.

KANADE.note: Espada harmônica de Lyner que dedilha uma melodia suave a cada golpe e ergue escudo sonoro.

Power Cylinder.note: Cilindro-chave para desligamento de emergência do gerador de força (JP パワーシリンダー).

Dokkoi Set.note: ドッコイ定食. Refeição substancial e tradicional consumida em Platina e Sol Ciel.

Tranquility.note: トランキリティ. Remédio calmante / item tático consumível de Grathmeld usado em combate para restaurar e estabilizar o canto das Reyvateils.

First Era.note: 第一紀. A era primordial da civilização de Sol Ciel antes da Primeira Calamidade, quando Shurelia convivia com sua figura paterna / criador.

Second Era.note: 第二紀. A era de reconstrução pós-primeira catástrofe com companheiros valorosos, encerrada pela traição humana e pela Grande Calamidade (Second Disaster).

Third Era.note: 第三紀. A era atual de isolamento de Sol Ciel, na qual Shurelia viveu centenas de anos em reclusão burocrática e solidão absoluta na Torre.

Song Stone.note: 唄石. Mineral cristalino ressonante que armazena melodias e energia fônica; a maior réplica de Sol Ciel é o monumento central do parque de Nemo.

Musical Corridor.note: Trecho da Torre onde ondas sonoras e fônicas alteram as cores luminosas de paredes e pisos, causando fadiga ocular em Aurica.

Kitty Candy.note: Doce felino vendido por Spica que serve de fachada para a senha do mercado clandestino de Cristais Grathnode.

Crescent Chronicle.note: Obra literária de romance acompanhada e discutida pelos personagens durante o descanso.

Pheyna Gate.note: Grande portão de acesso que protege as instalações vitais da Torre (JP フェーナ門).

Hexagonal Plate.note: Enorme estrutura suspensa que desabou sobre o mundo inferior causando devastação massiva (JP 六角板).

Mr. Pochoma.note: Venerável mestre Grathmelder lendário do vilarejo rural que derrotou as feras (JP ポチョマー先生).

Flute.note: Líder e guardião honorável da Tribo Teru no Portão Pheyna (JP フラウト様).

Silvaplate.note: Enorme placa e estrutura arquitetônica externa que sustenta os níveis inferiores da Torre Ar tonelico (JP シルヴァプレート).

Ion Plate.note: Seção intermediária da Torre Ar tonelico envolta em nuvens perpétuas (JP イオンプレート).

The Gather.note: Plataforma de observação estelar e ponto de ancoragem subterrâneo em Platina (JP ギャザー(星見台)).

lead_in_context_read_only.speaker: Sistema / Narração
lead_in_context_read_only.original_jp: ヴァテイルだが、その具現化に必要な力は塔から享受する。レーヴァテイルは詩魔法を唱えているとき、塔と繋がっているのだ。
lead_in_context_read_only.original_en: Reyvateil are the ones who craft the magic, but the energy needed for the physical manifestation is received by the Tower. This means that Reyvateil are connected to the Tower when they sing a Song Magic.
lead_in_context_read_only.text_ptbr: Embora tecida pela donzela, a energia para sua materialização é fornecida pelo núcleo da Torre. Ao entoar a Magia da Canção, a Reyvateil entra em comunhão direta com o servidor.

lead_in_context_read_only.speaker: Sistema / Narração
lead_in_context_read_only.original_jp: この世界のありとあらゆるモノを開発し、そしてこの世界を技術的に潤す大企業。その分野は多岐にわたり、生活必需品から軍隊まで、様々。CR天覇は様々な分野でレーヴァテイルの力を使っている。
lead_in_context_read_only.original_en: A large corporation that has developed many things, and has technologically advanced this world. They have many branches of companies from basic necessities to armed forces. Tenba use the power of Reyvateil in many of these areas.
lead_in_context_read_only.text_ptbr: O conglomerado industrial hegemônico que desenvolve grande parte da tecnologia de Sol Ciel. Atua desde bens de consumo até armamentos bélicos, explorando os dons das Reyvateils em múltiplos setores.

lead_in_context_read_only.speaker: Sistema / Narração
lead_in_context_read_only.original_jp: 特に軍隊の中には戦闘用のレーヴァテイルが多数在籍している。天覇は、人が入ることを許されていない塔の中枢に入り込み、その古代期の文明を持ちだして自分たちの技術にするという事を行っている。
lead_in_context_read_only.original_en: Especially in the armed forces, there are many Reyvateil registered as fighters.  Tenba enter the central system of the Tower where people are normally not allowed to go, and retrieve techonology from the ancient civilization to make it their own.
lead_in_context_read_only.text_ptbr: Em suas divisões militares, inúmeras Reyvateils são mantidas como armas vivas. A Tenba invade setores proibidos da Torre para pilhar relíquias da civilização antiga e monopolizar suas descobertas.

lead_in_context_read_only.speaker: Sistema / Narração
lead_in_context_read_only.original_jp: それによって人々の生活は大いに潤い、豊かになった。しかし、外敵から人々を守る生活保障などの面で、多少高額な金額を請求したりと、評判の悪い一面があるのも事実。
lead_in_context_read_only.original_en: Because of this, many peoples’ lives have become better. But they do have a bad reputation for taking a lot of money in exchange for protecting peoples’ lifestyles from outside enemies.
lead_in_context_read_only.text_ptbr: Embora tenha trazido prosperidade material, cobra tarifas extorsivas para proteger os cidadãos contra ameaças externas, o que gera grande rancor popular contra seus métodos.

lead_in_context_read_only.speaker: Sistema / Narração
lead_in_context_read_only.original_jp: 最近ではレーヴァテイルの扱いが極端に粗雑であるとのことで、一部から非難の声が出ている。
lead_in_context_read_only.original_en: Recently, they have been criticized for treating their Reyvateil extremely harsh.
lead_in_context_read_only.text_ptbr: Recentemente, tem sido criticada pelo tratamento brutal às Reyvateils.

lead_in_context_read_only.speaker: Sistema / Narração
lead_in_context_read_only.original_jp: この世界の標準的な技術体系の一つ。「グラスノ結晶」を用いて複数アイテムを合成することで、特別な力を持ったアイテムを作り出す技術。
lead_in_context_read_only.original_en: A standard form of technology in this world. A skill in which you can create items with special powers by using a [Grathnode Crystal] to synthesize multiple items.
lead_in_context_read_only.text_ptbr: Uma das técnicas elementares de Sol Ciel: emprega Cristais Grathnode para fundir diferentes materiais e criar artefatos com propriedades arcanas extraordinárias.

lead_in_context_read_only.speaker: Sistema / Narração
lead_in_context_read_only.original_jp: 大昔からそこかしこに落ちている、特殊な力を秘めた結晶。アイテムとかけ合わせれば特殊な効果が付いたアイテムを作ることが出来、レーヴァテイルにインストールすれば、そのレーヴァテイルの詩魔法が強くなるという優れもの。
lead_in_context_read_only.original_en: A crystal with special hidden powers that can be found all around the world since ancient times. By combining it with items, you can create an item with a special effect, and by installing in Reyvateils, you can make their Song Magic stronger.
lead_in_context_read_only.text_ptbr: Cristais milenares impregnados de força cósmica encontrados por toda parte. Na síntese, concedem propriedades mágicas aos itens; instalados em Reyvateils, potencializam grandemente suas Magias da Canção.

lead_in_context_read_only.speaker: Sistema / Narração
lead_in_context_read_only.original_jp: 現在の文明がここまで発展したのは、グラスノ結晶のお陰と言っても過言ではない。その能力は、グラスノ結晶ごとに全く違う。
lead_in_context_read_only.original_en: It wouldn’t be wrong to say that current civilization was able to come this far thanks to these Grathnode Crystals. Each Grathnode Crystal has a different ability.
lead_in_context_read_only.text_ptbr: Não é exagero afirmar que a civilização atual só prosperou graças aos Cristais Grathnode. Cada cristal possui matrizes e qualidades totalmente singulares.

lead_in_context_read_only.speaker: Sistema / Narração
lead_in_context_read_only.original_jp: 世界中に散らばっている、誰が作ったのかもわからない、グラスメルクの合成方法が記されたカード。このカードをゲットすることで、新たな組み合わせで新たなアイテムを
lead_in_context_read_only.original_en: A card that tells you the crafting method for Grathmelding. No one knows who made them, but they are scattered throughout the world.
lead_in_context_read_only.text_ptbr: Cartas anônimas com receitas de Grathmeld. Ao obtê-las, você desvenda novas fórmulas para criar itens inéditos.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: 作り出すことが出来るようになる。
dialogues.original_en: By obtaining these cards, you can combine different items to create a new item.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Obter essas cartas permite combinar ingredientes em novos itens.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: アルトレカ
dialogues.original_en: Ar Tonelicard
dialogues.current_ptbr: Ar Tonelicard

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: レシピカードを含めた、この世界に散らばっているカード群の総称。アルトレカには、レシピカード、人物カード、敵カード、ひみつカードの4種類のカード体系が存在する。
dialogues.original_en: A general term for all the cards, including Recipe Cards, that can be found all over this world. There are four types of Ar Tonelicards: Recipe Cards, Person Cards, Enemy Cards, and Secret Cards.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Nome geral das cartas encontradas pelo mundo. Há quatro tipos de Ar Tonelicard: Receita, Pessoa, Inimigo e Segredo.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: それぞれに通し番号も付いているため、コンプリートしないと気が済まない人達が続出し、ちょっとした社会問題にまで発展している。
dialogues.original_en: Each are numbered in a series, making people want to complete finding all the sets.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Todas têm numeração em série, incentivando coleções completas.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: テル族
dialogues.original_en: Teru Tribe
dialogues.current_ptbr: Tribo Teru

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: 塔の中腹、シルヴァホルンの近くに住んでいる種族。ドラゴンとのハーフのような人達で、頭に角があり、しっぽを生やしているのが特徴。
dialogues.original_en: A group of people who live on the side of the Tower, near Silvahorn. They are like a half-dragon half-human kind of people with a tail and a horn on their head.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Povo que vive na lateral da Torre, perto de Silvahorn. Parecem uma mistura de humanos e dragões, com cauda e chifre.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: 第二紀の終焉の時に、エレミアの使徒達と一緒にウイルスからこの地を護った一族でもある。
dialogues.original_en: They also protected the lands from viruses with the Apostles of Elemia at the end of the second era.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Também combateram os vírus com os Apóstolos de Elemia no fim da Segunda Era.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: 人々が何度もこの世界を崩壊に追いやるのは、持てあますほどの文明の力が原因であるとし、人々が塔の探索をするのを阻止する。
dialogues.original_en: They believe that people lead this world to destruction over and over again because of their overabundance of power in their civilization. Therefore, they try to prevent people from searching the Tower.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Acreditam que o poder excessivo da civilização leva repetidamente à destruição. Por isso, impedem a exploração da Torre.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: A.B.R.
dialogues.original_en: A. B. R.
dialogues.current_ptbr: A. B. R.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: 第一紀の頃、塔の守護をするために開発された特殊戦闘用ガーディアン。全部で三種類有り、それぞれが別々に行動可能。またドッキングすることで更なる強さを得る。
dialogues.original_en: A special forces guardian created to protect the Tower during the first era. There are three kinds, which can all move around on their own. They can also dock together, making them even more powerful.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Guardião especial da Primeira Era. Há três modelos independentes que podem se combinar para ganhar poder.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: 本当の名前は、CR#1Auto Blocker and Rotator.##CR変形型自動防護機構。
dialogues.original_en: Its real name is the Auto Blocker & Rotator. A transforming type, automatic guarding mechanism.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Seu nome é Auto Blocker & Rotator: mecanismo automático de defesa transformável.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: エレミアの使徒のみが使えると言われている特殊技能。CRレーヴァテイルの詩と自らの武器をシンクロさせることによって、共鳴効果のような増幅を起こす。
dialogues.original_en: A unique skill that only the Apostles of Elemia can use. By synchronizing a Reyvateil’s song and their own weapon, they create an amplification much like a resonance effect.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Técnica exclusiva dos Apóstolos de Elemia. Sincroniza arma e Canção de Reyvateil, amplificando ambas por ressonância.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: ハーモニクスが発生すると、武器は詩魔法の効果によって、詩魔法はその共鳴力によって、それぞれが飛躍的にパワーアップする。
dialogues.original_en: When Harmonics is activated, the weapon will greatly power up from the effects of the song, and the Song Magic will also power up with power of resonance.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Harmonics fortalece muito a arma pelos efeitos da Canção e também fortalece a magia por ressonância.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: クラスA~D
dialogues.original_en: Class A~D
dialogues.current_ptbr: Classe A~D

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: ホルスの民がレーヴァテイルの持つ力を認識するときに使う指標。A~Dまでが存在し、中でもAが最も強いとされるCRレーヴァテイルである。
dialogues.original_en: A classification that the people of Horus use to recognize the powers that a Reyvateil has. Ranks exist from A through D, Class A being the strongest of the Reyvateil.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Classificação de poder das Reyvateils usada em Horus. Vai de A a D, sendo A a mais forte.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: 生まれて間もない頃に行われる六角板試験(六角形のグラスノ結晶を肌に当て、めり込めば陽性。そのめりこみ具合によってクラスが決定される)によって判定される。
dialogues.original_en: This classification is decided shortly after birth by a Hexagon Test (A hexagonal Grathnode Crystal is pressed on the skin. The result is positive if it is absorbed. The class depends on how much of the crystal was absorbed.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Definida após o nascimento pelo Teste Hexagonal: pressiona-se um Cristal Grathnode hexagonal na pele. Se for absorvido, o teste é positivo. A quantidade absorvida determina a classe.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: クラスという概念自体は単なるレーヴァテイル能力の指標でしかないが、これがもたらす影響は多大である。なぜなら、この判定がAとDとでは、生活の保障度合が全然変わってくるからである。
dialogues.original_en: The idea of class was only to serve as an indicator of a Reyvateil’s power, but it also affects their life.This classification can greatly change the lifestyle guarantee of a Class A from a Class D.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Era apenas uma medida de poder, mas afeta a vida da Reyvateil. As garantias de sustento de uma classe A diferem muito das de uma classe D.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: エレミア三謳神
dialogues.original_en: Trio of Elemia
dialogues.current_ptbr: Trio de Elemia

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: エル・エレミア教会のご神体であり、過去に実在したと言われている神様。その名前を「ティリア」「エオリア」CR「フレリア」という。
dialogues.original_en: The Elemia Church worships these goddesses who are said to have actually existed in the past. Their names were [Tyria] [Eoria] and [Frelia].
dialogues.current_ptbr: Deusas que a Igreja de Elemia diz terem existido: [Tyria], [Eoria] e [Frelia].

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: エル・エレミア伝承によれば、彼女たちは謳うだけで世界全体を癒すことが出来たという。全てに於いて、真偽は明らかになっていない。
dialogues.original_en: According to the Elemia Legends, they were able to heal the whole world just by singing. But there is no proof of truth to any of it.
dialogues.current_ptbr: As lendas dizem que curavam o mundo inteiro cantando, mas não há prova disso.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: レーヴァテイルの心の中の世界「コスモスフィア」に入り込むこと。主な目的は、レーヴァテイルに新しい詩を紡いでもらうため。ダイブをしてコスモスフィアで事件が起こると、その鮮烈な感情は詩を紡ぎ出す。
dialogues.original_en: A term used to enter a Cosmosphere inside a Reyvateil’s mind. The main purpose is for the Reyvateil to craft new Songs. By diving and causing events to happen, a new Song can be crafted from those vivid emotions.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Mergulho é entrar na Cosmosfera da Reyvateil. Eventos provocam emoções intensas que permitem criar novas Canções.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: レーヴァテイルは現実世界で一人で詩を紡ぐことも出来るが、ダイブを行った方が、その数十倍~数百倍のスピードで修得が可能なのである。
dialogues.original_en: Reyvateil can craft songs alone in the real world too, but diving allows her to acquire them much quicker.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Ela também cria Canções sozinha no mundo real, mas mergulhar acelera o processo.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: コスモスフィア
dialogues.original_en: Cosmosphere
dialogues.current_ptbr: Cosmosfera

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: レーヴァテイルの精神世界の正式名称。
dialogues.original_en: The standard name for a Reyvateil’s soulspace.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Nome técnico do Espaço da Alma de uma Reyvateil.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: 「弱延命剤」といわれるもので、詩を謳うことで一時的に失われてしまった生命力を回復させることが出来るアイテム。これの対でダイキリティ(重延命剤)というものもあ
dialogues.original_en: A weak life extention agent which is an item that will recover temporarily lost energy from singing a song. There is also the Diquility (a strong life extention agent), usually refered to as the life extending agent.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Agente fraco que repõe temporariamente a energia gasta ao cantar. Diquilidade é o agente forte, normalmente chamado de prolongador de vida.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: る。こちらが俗に「延命剤」と呼ばれるもので、レーヴァテイル第三世代が、3ヶ月に1度投与されないと生きていけないもの。
dialogues.original_en: Third generation Reyvateil need to be administered this agent every three months in order to live.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Reyvateils de terceira geração precisam desse agente a cada três meses para viver.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: 猫飴
dialogues.original_en: Kitty Candy
dialogues.current_ptbr: Bala felina

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: ほたる横丁の名物。猫飴売りのスピカの専売品。この飴をなめると猫と話が出来るようになる...という噂だが、話が出来るようになったという証言は聞いたことはない。由来
dialogues.original_en: A Firefly Alley favorite. The Kitty Candy seller, Spica, is the only one who sells these. If you eat this candy, you will be able to talk with cats...but this is just a rumor, and there is no proof that anyone has actually been able to talk with cats.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Especialidade vendida só por Spica no Beco Vagalume. Dizem que a Bala felina permite conversar com gatos, mas ninguém provou.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: は、ほたる横丁の核動力部付近にノラネコが沢山住み着いていて、猫自体がほたる横丁の名物であることからだと言われている。
dialogues.original_en: The name comes from Firefly Alley’s local feature: cats. Many stray cats have gathered in Firefly Alley’s nuclear power sector, making them a local favorite.
dialogues.current_ptbr: O nome vem dos gatos de rua reunidos no setor nuclear do Beco Vagalume, um símbolo local.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: ほたる横丁
dialogues.original_en: Firefly Alley
dialogues.current_ptbr: Beco Vagalume

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: 企業天覇による「雲海調査のための学術都市構想」によって生まれた、完全人工浮遊島。
dialogues.original_en: A completely man-made floating island created by Tenba Corporation’s project, [Academy City Concept for Research on the Sea of Clouds].
dialogues.current_ptbr: Ilha flutuante artificial da Tenba, criada no projeto [Cidade Acadêmica para Pesquisa do Mar de Nuvens].

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: 最初は研究者が多く住んでいたが、その後様々な人が移住し、現在では空港都市ネモに次ぐ活気有る街と言っても過言ではない。現在は、開発当初の市街である内側の市街地と、現在最も栄えている外側の市街に分かれている。
dialogues.original_en: At first, only the scientists lived on this island, but later on, many people began to move onto this island, and now it is almost as lively as the Airport City of Nemo.
dialogues.current_ptbr: No início viviam apenas cientistas, mas chegaram muitos moradores. Hoje é quase tão animada quanto Nemo.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: また、一定の大きさで区切りながら都市を拡張していく形式のため、ほたる横丁内の各ブロックは簡単に行き来できない。
dialogues.original_en: Currently, there is a division between the old inner city and the prosperous, present day outer city.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Divide-se na cidade interna antiga e na externa, próspera e atual.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: たいていの場合は、市電(といってもトロッコのようなもの)を使って移動することになる。それぞれの駅を中心に、一つのブロックが有るような形になっている。
dialogues.original_en: Also, because the city is expanded by set divisions, it is not easy to get from one block to another. Most of the time, you will need to travel by tram (more like a trolley). It is structured so that each station is in the center of each block.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Os setores são separados, dificultando o trânsito entre eles. Usa-se um bonde, com estação no centro de cada setor.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: 当初、学術研究都市として作られただけのことはあり、現在でもそれが色濃く出ている。様々な所に様々な研究施設や工場などがあり、ネモとは全く違う雰囲気で活気のある街なのである。
dialogues.original_en: Since it was originally designed to be an Academy Research City, there are many labratories and research facilities in the area. It has a different atmosphere than Nemo, but is still lively in a different way.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Projetada como cidade acadêmica, tem muitos laboratórios e centros de pesquisa. É diferente de Nemo, mas animada à sua maneira.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: FFTスペクトラム認証
dialogues.original_en: FFT Spectrum Authentication
dialogues.current_ptbr: Autenticação espectro FFT

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: 人やレーヴァテイルが発する生態エネルギーを、その波動成分別に分波すると、全ての生命は完全に違う周波数成分を持つ。
dialogues.original_en: Humans and Reyvateil emit a life energy which can be fractioned into a spectrum of frequency waves. This component spectrum is completely unique to every individual.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Humanos e Reyvateils emitem energia vital com um espectro de frequências único para cada indivíduo.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: その成分マップを認証鍵として認証するのがFFTスペクトラム認証である。ただ立つだけで認識されるため何の面倒もなく、それ故文明の絶頂期には標準的に使われていた認証方法である。
dialogues.original_en: A map of this component is used as a authentication key for the FFT Spectrum Authenticator. Since the process only requires you to simply stand in front of it, this authenticating process was used standardly in past civilizations.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Esse espectro serve de chave ao Autenticador FFT. Basta ficar diante dele; a civilização antiga usava esse método amplamente.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: 身近なところでは家の鍵から、重要隔壁に至るまで、この方式が採用されていた。
dialogues.original_en: This method was used as house keys and passes to important sectors of the Tower.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Servia para abrir casas e acessar setores importantes da Torre.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: 隔壁ゲート
dialogues.original_en: Division Gate
dialogues.current_ptbr: Portão Divisor

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: 塔は、一番中心から3つの区画に分かれている。そして一番中心の区画と中間区画を隔てるゲートを「A隔壁」といい、中間区画と塔の外壁を隔てるゲートを「B隔壁」とい
dialogues.original_en: The Tower is divided into three areas from the center out. The gate that separates the central and middle areas is called the [A Dividing Gate], and the gate that separates the middle area from the outer walls is called the [B Dividing Gate].
dialogues.current_ptbr: A Torre tem três regiões concêntricas. O [Portão Divisor A] separa a central da intermediária; o [Portão Divisor B], a intermediária da muralha externa.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: う。A隔壁は、A1~A9までの9つの隔壁がある。B隔壁も同様だが、1つの数字を持つ隔壁が複数存在するのが常である。ただし、塔がロストテクノロジーとなった今、外壁は徐々に朽ち、B隔壁の殆どはなくなってしまった。
dialogues.original_en: The A Dividing Gate has 9 gates, from A1 to A9. The same is true for the B Dividing Gate, except that it has multiple gates with the same number. Since the Tower is lost technology, the outer walls have eroded, and many of the B Gates are gone.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Há nove portões A, de A1 a A9. Os B repetem números. A erosão das paredes externas destruiu muitos portões B.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: ドッコイ定食
dialogues.original_en: Dokkoi Set
dialogues.current_ptbr: Combo Dokkoi

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: ほたる横丁の定食屋では有名な定食。とにかくボリュームが大きく、大抵の人は食べられる量ではない。また、内容もバラエティに富んでおり、非常にお得な定食である。
dialogues.original_en: A famous combo meal you can get from eateries in Firefly Alley. It has quite generous portions, and is very hard for normal people to finish the whole meal. But it does have a good variety of selections, making it worth the price.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Combo famoso do Beco Vagalume. As porções são difíceis de terminar, mas a variedade faz valer o preço.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: ドッコイ定食のドッコイはCR「どっ濃い(超濃い)」から来ているという噂があるが、定かではない。
dialogues.original_en: The rumor behind the ”Dokkoi” in Dokkoi Set is...well, no one knows.
dialogues.current_ptbr: A origem de 'Dokkoi' no Combo Dokkoi... bem, ninguém sabe.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: ティリア神
dialogues.original_en: Goddess Tyria
dialogues.current_ptbr: Deusa Tyria

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: エレミア三謳神の1柱。詳細は、エル・エレミア教会で。
dialogues.original_en: One of the three goddesses in the Trio of Elemia. Ask for details at the Elemia Church.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Uma das três deusas do Trio de Elemia. Peça detalhes à Igreja de Elemia.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: ブラストライン
dialogues.original_en: Blastline
dialogues.current_ptbr: Blastline

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: プラティナの上空、200ストン程にあるプラズマの海。大昔、大惨事『グラスノインフェリア』によって大量の導力が放出され、あまりのエネルギーの大きさにそれが
dialogues.original_en: A sea of plasma about 200 stons above Platina. A long time ago, during the tragedy of the [Grathno Inferia], huge amounts of symphonic power was released. It was so much energy that it had turned into plasma.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Mar de plasma cerca de 200 stons acima de Platina. Surgiu quando a tragédia [Inferia Grathnode] liberou tanta energia sinfônica que ela virou plasma.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: プラズマ化してしまった。生身の人間が中に入れば死は免れない。
dialogues.original_en: If a person without the proper protection goes in, they will die for sure.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Entrar sem proteção adequada é morte certa.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: ストン(単位)
dialogues.original_en: Ston (Unit)
dialogues.current_ptbr: Ston (Unidade)

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: 距離の単位。1ストンは、約3mである。CRこれは、塔を形成する巨大な石のサイズを1単位としたもの。
dialogues.original_en: A unit of distance measurement. 1ston is about 3 meters. This unit is the size of one of the giant stones that makes up the Tower.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Unidade de distância. Um ston vale cerca de três metros, o tamanho de uma grande pedra da Torre.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: グラスノインフェリア
dialogues.original_en: Grathnode Inferior
dialogues.current_ptbr: Inferia Grathnode

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: まだ塔が生きていた頃の世界、第一紀終焉のきっかけとなった大惨事の呼び名。
dialogues.original_en: The name for the first apocalypse at the end of the first era when the Tower was still alive. A huge amount of symphonic power had poured out of the Tower all at once, causing a sea of plasma to be created in the atmosphere.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Primeiro apocalipse, no fim da Primeira Era. A Torre liberou enorme energia sinfônica de uma vez, formando um mar de plasma no céu.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: 塔から一度に大量の導力があふれ出し、それにより大気中にプラズマの海を形成、大地は砕かれ、その巻き上がる噴煙は死の雲海を形成した。
dialogues.original_en: The earth broke apart and the eruptions created a deadly sea of clouds.
dialogues.current_ptbr: A terra se partiu e as erupções criaram um mar de nuvens mortal.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: ユーテリア
dialogues.original_en: Yuteria
dialogues.current_ptbr: Yuteria

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: 塔が大惨事で崩壊した直後の時代、第二紀とよばれる文明期に作られた素材。主に建設用材として作られたもので、軽金属である。成分としてグラスノ結晶を大量に含む。第
dialogues.original_en: A material created in the second era, shortly after the Tower had been destroyed in the apocalypse. It is a light metal mainly used as construction material. It contains grathnode crystals as its main element.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Material da Segunda Era, criado após o apocalipse. Metal leve de construção que tem Cristais Grathnode como principal componente.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: 三紀でも、それに近い素材は作られているが、ここまでの純度のものはまだ作られていない。
dialogues.original_en: Similar material is also made in the third era, but they cannot be created as purely as this.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Na Terceira Era fazem material parecido, mas sem a mesma pureza.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: 導力
dialogues.original_en: Symphonic Power
dialogues.current_ptbr: Poder sinfônico

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: 導力エネルギーという。塔を動かすための命の源であり、更には情報伝達能力をも持つ。導力は大気中に非常に低い密度で存在しており、それを吸収する石「唄石」によって濃縮されて力として具現化する。
dialogues.original_en: Also known as symphonic energy. The source of life of the Tower, which also has informational network capabilities. Symphonic power exists at a very low density in the atmosphere, which is then absorbed by rocks called Song Stone.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Também chamada energia sinfônica: alimenta a Torre e transmite informações. Existe diluída no ar e é absorvida pelas Pedras de Canção.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: その単純な原理を、無限のパワーにまで持ち上げたものが、塔アルトネリコなのである。
dialogues.original_en: This can then be concentrated and turned into a physical form. This fundamental principle was raised to an infinite level with the creation of the Tower Ar Tonelico.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Pode ser concentrada e assumir forma física. A criação da Torre Ar Tonelico levou esse princípio a um nível ilimitado.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: 唄石(しょうせき)
dialogues.original_en: Song Stone
dialogues.current_ptbr: Pedra-canto

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: この世界の魔法の源「導力」を吸収し、濃縮する力を持つ、導力充電池のような石。この石を精錬すると、グラスノ結晶とパラメノ結晶が生成される。
dialogues.original_en: This stone can absorb [Symphonic Power], the source of this world’s magic. It can store the energy, making it like a Symphonic Battery. By refining this stone, you can create Grathnode Crystals and Parameno Crystals.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Pedra que armazena [Energia Sinfônica], como uma bateria. Seu refino produz Cristais Grathnode e Parameno.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: 彩音回廊
dialogues.original_en: Musical Corridor
dialogues.current_ptbr: Corredor musical

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: 塔の丁度中央付近に、7枚の石の板を周囲にとりまく場所がある。それが彩音回廊である。彩音回廊は、この世界の天候や環境を制御する、ウェザーコントローラーである。
dialogues.original_en: Near the middle of the Tower is a place surrounded by 7 stone slabs. That is the Musical Corridor. It is the climate control that adjusts this world’s weather and evironment.
dialogues.current_ptbr: O Corredor Musical fica entre sete placas de pedra, próximo ao meio da Torre. Regula o clima e o ambiente do mundo.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: それ以外にも、高々度における有害電波などの除去も行っている。彩音回廊の機能が停止したときが、この世界終焉の時と言っても過言ではない。
dialogues.original_en: It also eliminates hazardous radiation in high altitudes. It’s fair to say that when the Musical Corridor ceases its function, the world will come to an end.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Também elimina radiação perigosa em grandes altitudes. Se parar, o mundo chega ao fim.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: フェーナ門
dialogues.original_en: Pheyna Gate
dialogues.current_ptbr: Portão Pheyna

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: テル族が『エレミア誓約書』に基づいて創りあげた巨大な門。その目的は、ホルスの民(下層人間)をクレセントクロニクル、彩音回廊など重要施設のひしめくイオンプレー
dialogues.original_en: A huge gate created by the Teru Tribe based on the [Elemia Oath].
dialogues.current_ptbr: Grande portão construído pelos Teru conforme o [Juramento de Elemia].

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: トより上へ行けないようにするため。
dialogues.original_en: Its purpose is to prevent the people of Wings of Horus (lower worlders) from going above the Ion Plate where important facilities such as the Crescent Chronicle and Musical Corridor exist.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Impede que moradores das Asas de Horus subam além da Placa Iônica, onde ficam a Crônica Crescente e o Corredor Musical.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: 星詠
dialogues.original_en: Star Singer
dialogues.current_ptbr: Cantora das Estrelas

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: この世界の脅威である「ウイルス」の母体、ミュールを封印する役目を負ったレーヴァテイルのこと。星詠はミュールを封印するために、祭壇クレセントクロニクルで一生謳い続けなければならない。
dialogues.original_en: The Reyvateil who is given the task to keep Mir, the mother of all viruses, sealed. The Star Singer must continue to sing in the altar of Crecent Chronicle her entire life in order to keep Mir asleep. Misha is the 31st.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Reyvateil encarregada de manter Mir selada. Deve cantar por toda a vida no altar da Crônica Crescente. Misha é a 31ª Cantora das Estrelas.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: ミシャはその31代目。星詠は世界の命運を背負う事になるため、人間では役不足であり、故にβ純血種によって行われている。
dialogues.original_en: Because the Star Singer is responsible for everyone’s lives, Humans are unable to do this task, and therefore, only the βpure blood Reyvateils are chosen.
dialogues.current_ptbr: A tarefa envolve a vida de todos e não pode ser feita por humanos. Só Reyvateils β de sangue puro são escolhidas.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: クロニクルキー
dialogues.original_en: Chronicle Key
dialogues.current_ptbr: Chave Crônica

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: 「ウイルス」の母体、ミュールを封印するために紡がれた詩。ミュールの魂を眠りに就かせる子守唄のような詩である。現時点で、最も新しいCRヒュムノスであり、第三紀に紡がれた唯一のヒュムノスでもある。ミシャしか歌うことが出来ない。
dialogues.original_en: The song crafted to seal the mother of all viruses, Mir. It is much like a lullaby that keeps Mir’s soul asleep. This is currently the newest Hymn Crystal, and the only one crafted in the third era. Only Misha can sing this.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Canção que mantém a alma de Mir adormecida. É o Cristal Hino mais novo e o único criado na Terceira Era. Só Misha pode cantá-la.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: サーキュラの洗礼
dialogues.original_en: Circular Baptism
dialogues.current_ptbr: Batismo circular

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: テル族的に言えば「一度死を迎え、魂となりて塔と繋がる儀式」。その科学的なロジックはウイルスELMA-DSが行っているのと同じ、
dialogues.original_en: In the words of the Teru, it is ”the ritual in which you must accept death and allow your soul to connect to the Tower.”
dialogues.current_ptbr: Para os Teru, é o ritual de aceitar a morte e permitir que a alma se conecte à Torre.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: フリップフロップ変換による、物質化<>情報化を行っているに過ぎない。もっとわかりやすく言えば、テレポートである。
dialogues.original_en: The logic behind it is the same as ELMA-DS’s flip-flop conversion from physical form to information form. Even more simply put, it is teleportation.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Usa o mesmo princípio da conversão flip-flop de ELMA-DS: transforma matéria em informação. Simplificando, é teletransporte.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: 石木
dialogues.original_en: Stonetree
dialogues.current_ptbr: Árvore-pedra

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: テル族の町イム・フェーナを形成する、成長する石。石自体が自我を持っていて、強い想いに反応して、その想いを形作る。
dialogues.original_en: Growing rocks that form the town of the Teru Tribe, Em Pheyna. The stone itself has a mind of its own and will react to strong wills when creating its shape.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Rochas que crescem e formam Em Pheyna. Têm mente própria e moldam-se conforme uma vontade forte.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: ただし、成長速度がかなり遅いため、相当長い間かけて同じ思いを紡がなければ、ちゃんとした形にはならない。それ故、人間に石木を思い通りに成長させることは難しい。イム・フェーナの建物は全部石木で造られている。
dialogues.original_en: But it grows very slow, requiring a pretty long time of the same strong will to create the desired shape. Therefore, it is very difficult for Humans to grow Stonetree the way the want.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Crescem devagar e exigem concentração prolongada. Por isso, humanos têm dificuldade em moldá-las.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: そしてその家の一軒一軒は全て、その家の主人の思い描いた家の形になっているのだ。
dialogues.original_en: All buildings of Em Pheyna are built by Stonetree, and each house is shaped by the owner’s will.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Todas as construções de Em Pheyna usam Árvore-pedra, moldadas pela vontade do dono.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: エレミア誓約書
dialogues.original_en: Elemia Oath
dialogues.current_ptbr: Juramento de Elemia

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: 第一紀、第二紀崩壊のきっかけとなった、持てあますほどの塔の力の乱用を防ぐために出来た、幾つかの規則と使命を綴った書物。
dialogues.original_en: Laws and tasks were assigned and written in this book to prevent misuse of the tremendous powers of the Tower, which triggered the end of the first and second era.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Livro de leis e deveres para impedir o mau uso da Torre, que causou o fim da Primeira e da Segunda Era.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: 第二紀終焉時に人類の滅亡を防いだエレミアの使徒たちと、それに協力したテル族との間で交わされ、それぞれ使命を持ちプラティナとイム・フェーナに住んでいる。
dialogues.original_en: It is an oath between the Teru Tribe and the Apostles of Elemia who prevented the extinction of Humans at the end of the second era. They live in Em Pheyna and Platina, respectively, as a part of their task.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Juramento entre Teru e Apóstolos de Elemia, que salvaram a humanidade. Vivem em Em Pheyna e Platina para cumprir suas tarefas.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: テル族が人間を塔に近づけさせないのもフェーナ門を築いたのも、全てこの書物にしたがっているのである。
dialogues.original_en: The Teru also built a gate so that Humans wouldn’t come close to the Tower according to this book.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Conforme o livro, os Teru também construíram um portão para afastar humanos da Torre.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: ヒュムネコード
dialogues.original_en: Hymn Code
dialogues.current_ptbr: Código Hymmnos

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: レーヴァテイルについている識別子であり、いわゆるパスワードでもある。例えば、塔をコントロールするとき、CRヒュムネクリスタルをダウンロードするときなど、塔や詩魔法に関係する事を行うためには、大抵これが必要となる。その為、レーヴァテイルは自分自身でもヒュムネコードを知らず、それを知るためにはコスモスフィアに入り、探し出すしかない。故に、ヒュムネコードを知る為には、その
dialogues.original_en: An identifier on a Reyvateil, which also serves as a password. It is usually required to do anything related to the Tower and Song Magic, for example, controlling the Tower, or dowloading a Hymn Crystal.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Identificação da Reyvateil que também funciona como senha. Necessária para controlar a Torre e baixar Cristais Hino.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: レーヴァテイルから一定以上の信頼を得ないとならない。
dialogues.original_en: Most of the time, the Reyvateil herself does not know her own Hymn Code, To find it out, someone has to dive into her Cosmosphere. This means that in order to learn a Reyvateil’s Hymn Code, you must earn her trust first.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Geralmente nem ela sabe seu Código Hino. Alguém precisa mergulhar em sua Cosmosfera para descobri-lo, conquistando sua confiança.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: ダウンロード
dialogues.original_en: Download
dialogues.current_ptbr: Download

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: ヒュムネクリスタルの持つ、詩の「想い」を、レーヴァテイルの心の中に落とし込むこと。手続きにはヒュムノスワードによる呪文を唱える必要があり、その中にダウンロード先のレーヴァテイルのヒュムネコードも必要。
dialogues.original_en: The process in which the emotions of a Song in a Hymn Crystal is dropped into the mind of a Reyvateil. In order to do this, you need to chant the spell in Hymnos, and then the Hymn Code of the Reyvateil you want to download into.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Processo de transferir à Reyvateil as emoções de um Cristal Hino. Exige um encantamento em Hymmnos e o Código Hino da destinatária.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: これによって得るものは、詩のメロディなどの具体的なものではなく、色も形もないその詩の「想い」である。
dialogues.original_en: What the Revyateil acquires in this process is the raw emotions of the song, which is not the specific melody or lyrics.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Ela recebe as emoções puras, não uma melodia ou letra específica.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: その鮮烈な想いを心の中に落とし込むことで、ダウンロードされたレーヴァテイルは、自らで詩を紡ぎ出すのだ。故に、同じヒュムネクリスタルをダウンロードしても、違うレーヴァテイルなら全然違う詩になるのである。
dialogues.original_en: When these vivid emotions are downloaded into a Revyateil, she will craft her own song. Therefore, different Reyvateils will sing a different song even if they download the same Hymn Crystal.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Essas emoções a levam a criar sua própria Canção. Assim, o mesmo cristal produz cantos diferentes em Reyvateils diferentes.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: ホルスの翼
dialogues.original_en: Wings of Horus
dialogues.current_ptbr: Asas de Hórus

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: 第三紀と呼ばれる現在において、唯一土の大地を残した浮遊大陸。その大きさは北海道くらいであり、翼を広げた鳥のような形をしていることから、ホルスの翼と呼ばれるよ
dialogues.original_en: In this third era, it is the only floating earthen landform left. This floating continent is about 1/5 the size of California and is shaped like a bird with its wings spread out, therefore, named Wings of Horus.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Único continente de solo flutuante restante na Terceira Era. Tem cerca de um quinto da área da Califórnia e forma de ave com asas abertas: Asas de Horus.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: うになった。CR現在、ホルスの翼には空港都市ネモを中心に、数万人の人が住んでいる。最も辺境に位置する村がカルル村で、それよりも遠いところは現在開拓されていない。
dialogues.original_en: Currently, there are many thousands of people living on the Wings of Horus. The airport city of Nemo is considered the capital, and Karulu Village is the farthest out. The rest is still under development.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Milhares vivem nas Asas de Horus. Nemo é a capital, Karulu fica na extremidade e o restante ainda está em desenvolvimento.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: エル・エレミア伝承
dialogues.original_en: Elemia Legends
dialogues.current_ptbr: Lendas de Elemia

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: 遠い昔、三柱の神様がいた。その神様は、謳うだけで人を癒し、炎を飛ばし、この地と語ることができた。人々は神様の元で豊かで幸せな世界を築き上げた。これが理想郷エル・エレミアを語る、エル・エレミア伝承である。
dialogues.original_en: Long ago, there were three goddesses. They were able to heal, throw fire, and speak to the lands, just by singing. The people created a peaceful world under these goddesses. This is Elemia Legends that speaks of the utopia, Elemia.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Antigamente, três deusas curavam, lançavam fogo e falavam com a terra cantando. Sob elas, o povo criou a utopia Elemia, conforme as lendas.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: この伝承に登場する常世の国、エル・エレミアの再建と至福の時を目標としているのが、エル・エレミア教会である。
dialogues.original_en: The Elemia Church’s goal is to rebuild this legendary utopia and peace.
dialogues.current_ptbr: A Igreja busca restaurar essa utopia e sua paz.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: クレセントクロニクル
dialogues.original_en: Crescent Chronicle
dialogues.current_ptbr: Crônica Crescente

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: ウイルスの母であるミュールを封印しておくための祭壇。クレセントクロニクル自体は単なる祭壇である為、これだけでは封印効果としては弱い。これにミシャの謳うクロニク
dialogues.original_en: An altar created to seal the mother of viruses, Mir. The Crescent Chronicle itself is only an altar, so it cannot seal by itself. Combined with Misha’s song, Chronicle Key, its effects become very strong, and can bring Mir to a deep sleep.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Altar que sela Mir. Sozinho não tem esse poder, mas, junto da Chave da Crônica cantada por Misha, induz um sono profundo.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: ルキーが載ったとき、初めて強力な封印となって、ミュールは眠りの淵に落ちるのである。CRクレセントクロニクルはパイプオルガンのような形をしているが、これはミシャの謳うクロニクルキーを集音し、その詩でこの祭壇を取り囲むように共鳴させるためである。
dialogues.original_en: The Crescent Chronicle is shaped like a pipe organ. This is so that all the sounds of  Misha’s Chronicle Key can be picked up and resonated to surround the whole altar.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Tem forma de órgão de tubos para captar e ressoar todos os sons da Chave da Crônica ao redor do altar.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: β純血種
dialogues.original_en: β-Pure Blood
dialogues.current_ptbr: Sangue puro β

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: 混じりけない、100%レーヴァテイルといえば、β純血種である。完全にクローンとして遺伝子から組まれ生まれる。その能力は安定して強く、人間とレーヴァテイルとの混血である第三世代とは比較にならない。
dialogues.original_en: The β-Pure Blood Reyvateils are unmixed, 100% Reyvateil. They are complete clones set in DNA levels. Their abilities are stable and strong, uncomparable to the Third Generation, a mix between Humans and Reyvateils.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Reyvateils β de sangue puro são clones completos, 100% Reyvateil. Têm capacidades estáveis e fortes, diferentes da terceira geração mestiça.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: ただし、必ずしも第三世代より全部が強いわけでもない。第三世代の場合、偏って極端に強い力を発揮する分野が出来たりするのだが、この突飛な力には敵わないことが多い。
dialogues.original_en: But this does not mean they overpower the Third Generation completely. In the case of this Third Generation, some Reyvateil have extreme strengths in certain magics, but β-Pure Bloods do not have these extremes.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Isso não as torna superiores em tudo. Algumas de terceira geração têm poder extremo em certas magias, algo ausente nas β de sangue puro.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: 現在、β純血種はミシャを含めて非常にまれにしか存在しない。
dialogues.original_en: Currently, there are very few β-Pure Bloods, including Misha.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Restam poucas β de sangue puro, entre elas Misha.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: 第三世代
dialogues.original_en: Third Generation
dialogues.current_ptbr: Terceira geração

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: レーヴァテイルと人間との混血で、更にレーヴァテイルとしての能力が顕在化した人のことを第三世代という。第三世代は寿命が極端に短く、普通に生活していれば20歳を迎える前に死んでしまう。
dialogues.original_en: A mixed blood of Reyvateil and Humans, and further, those who appear to have the abilities of Reyvateil. Third Generation Reyvateil have very short life spans, and will die before the age of 20 without administering a life extension agent.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Descendentes de humanos e Reyvateils que manifestam seus poderes. Vivem menos de vinte anos sem agente de prolongamento de vida.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: 延命すれば普通の人間と同じ年を生きられるが、その為にはダイキリティと言われる延命剤を定期的に取り込まなければならない。
dialogues.original_en: They can live to the same age as Humans only if they are periodically given this life extension called Diquility.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Com doses periódicas de Diquilidade, podem viver tanto quanto humanos.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: 核動力部
dialogues.original_en: Nuclear Generator
dialogues.current_ptbr: Gerador nuclear

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: ほたる横丁を浮かせている機関のこと。フリッパーと呼ばれるディスクオルゴール盤のようなグラスノの板が回転することで、この島全体の浮力を得ている。これが落とされ
dialogues.original_en: The mechanism that keeps Firefly Alley afloat. The Flipper, a Grathnode plate that turns like the drum of a musical box, gives the whole island its bouyancy.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Mecanismo que mantém o Beco Vagalume flutuando. O Flipper é uma placa Grathnode que gira como o cilindro de uma caixa de música e sustenta a ilha.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: てしまうと、ほたる横丁は数十分と持たない。
dialogues.original_en: If this is destroyed, Firefly Alley will not last 20 minutes.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Se for destruído, Beco Vagalume não durará vinte minutos.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: パワーシリンダー
dialogues.original_en: Power Cylinder
dialogues.current_ptbr: Cilindro de energia

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: 天覇が開発した大規模導力起動用グロースタータ。これをソケットに差し込むと、その瞬間強烈な充導が起こり、瞬間的にもの凄い強烈な導力を発する事が出来る。それによ
dialogues.original_en: A large scale symphonic power starter that was developed by the Tenba. By pluging this into a socket, an immediate powerful charge occurs, allowing a momentary emission of symphonic power.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Acionador sinfônico de grande escala da Tenba. Ligado a uma tomada, fornece uma carga imediata e forte de energia sinfônica.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: って、導力エネルギーを使うメカの起動をスムーズに行える。ただし、使用中はパワーシリンダー自体が、動力のメインルートになる上、着脱可能であるため、セキュリティ的にはあまりよろしくないと言われている。
dialogues.original_en: By using this, a mech using symphonic energy can be activated smoother. But while its use, the Power Cylinder itself becomes the main route of power, but is also detachable, making it inefficient on a security level.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Facilita a ativação de máquinas sinfônicas. Porém, torna-se a principal via de energia e pode ser removido, prejudicando a segurança.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: 延命剤
dialogues.original_en: Life Extending Agent
dialogues.current_ptbr: Agente prolonga-vida

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: 延命剤にはトランキリティCR(瞬間延命剤)とCRダイキリティ(重延命剤)
dialogues.original_en: There are two types of life extending agents: Tranquility (temporary extension) and Diquility (longer extention).
dialogues.current_ptbr: Há dois agentes: Tranquilidade, de efeito temporário, e Diquilidade, de efeito duradouro.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: が存在するが、一言「延命剤」と言われるとき、それの指すものは「ダイキリティ」と呼ばれる重延命剤である。トランキリティは、詩を謳って一時的に失われた生命力を回復させるもの、ダイキリティは、恒久的に減っていく生命力を持ち上げるものである。故に、延命剤
dialogues.original_en: It is usually the Diquility when referring to a life extending agent. The Tranquility will recover life energy that is momentarily lost while singing in battle. Diquility refills on the  life energy that is continuously drained.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Prolongador de vida normalmente significa Diquilidade. Tranquilidade repõe a energia gasta no canto; Diquilidade repõe a perda contínua de energia vital.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: (ダイキリティ)の投与がされていないレーヴァテイルに、トランキリティだけを投与しても回復はしない。
dialogues.original_en: Therefore, a Reyvateil that is not administered Diquility will not recover from only giving her Tranquility.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Uma Reyvateil privada de Diquilidade não se recupera apenas com Tranquilidade.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: モンダカバブー
dialogues.original_en: Mondakababu
dialogues.current_ptbr: Mondakababu

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: オリカだけが知っていた謎の食材。スクワート地方に生息する植物であることはわかっているが、現在スクワート村の生き残りは殆どいないため、この植物自体の存在が謎に包まれつつある。
dialogues.original_en: A mysterious food ingredient that only Aurica knew about. It is known to be a unqiue plant in the Skuirt Area, but there are not many people from Skuirt Village who are still alive, so the plant itself is covered in mysteries.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Ingrediente misterioso conhecido por Aurica. É uma planta peculiar de Skuirt, mas há poucos sobreviventes da vila que saibam sobre ela.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: ババンゴ
dialogues.original_en: Babango
dialogues.current_ptbr: Babango

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: 世界一凶悪な食材と言われているもので、強烈な毒を持つ。しかし毒さえしっかり抜いてしまえば最強に美味しい野菜で、畑のティラミスと呼ばれている。
dialogues.original_en: It is said to be the most dangerous food ingredient in the world and carries a strong poison. But as long as all of the poison is removed, it is quite a delicacy and is called the tiramisu of the field.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Considerado o ingrediente mais perigoso do mundo, é muito venenoso. Se todo o veneno for removido, vira uma iguaria: o tiramisu do campo.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: 形は玉ねぎのような球根野菜だが、その味は似ても似つかない。
dialogues.original_en: It is shaped like an onion bulb, but its taste is nothing like it.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Parece um bulbo de cebola, mas o gosto é totalmente diferente.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: インストールポイント
dialogues.original_en: Installer Port
dialogues.current_ptbr: Porta de instalação

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: レーヴァテイルなら必ず身体のどこかにある、紋章のようなタトゥ。発生位置は、レーヴァテイルによって異なるが、全てのレーヴァテイルは、このインストールポイントからグラスノ結晶や延命剤を取り込むことが可能である。
dialogues.original_en: An emblem-like tattoo that all Reyvateils have on their body. Its location is different on each Reyvateil, but they all have this installer port where they can receive Grathnode Crystals and life extending agents.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Marca no corpo de toda Reyvateil. A posição varia, mas serve de porta para instalar cristais e agentes de prolongamento de vida.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: このタトゥの形から、大体のレーヴァテイルの派生がわかり、近い模様をしているレーヴァテイル同士は、子孫が近いということになる。
dialogues.original_en: The shape of these tattoos are similar within relatives, and gives a clue to who the descendants and children are.
dialogues.current_ptbr: O desenho se parece entre parentes, ajudando a identificar descendentes.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: 『謳姫と守護者』の像
dialogues.original_en: Statue of ”Singer and Protector”
dialogues.current_ptbr: Estátua da Cantora e do Protetor

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: エル・エレミア伝承と共に語り継がれている像。『遙かなるときより謳姫その謳う声在らば、そこに護りし者在り。西から風吹けば西に、東より雨降れば東に。
dialogues.original_en: A statue that is spoken and passed down along with the Elemia Legends. A poem goes with the statue: ”Since time began, where ever there was a singer, there was a protector.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Estátua das lendas de Elemia, acompanhada de um poema: 'Desde o início dos tempos, onde havia uma cantora, havia um protetor.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: その身朽ちても姫護らん。謳姫されど委ね信頼の絆ありて、初め世界を癒し潤す風...導けり』という伝承詩と共にあり、その詩の通り、レーヴァテイルの能力を発揮するためにパートナーである騎士の力が必要であることを説いている。
dialogues.original_en: The winds from the west would take them west; the rains from the east would take them east.Even if his body shall rot, he would protect her. A bond of trust between them will lead a breeze of healing to this world.”
dialogues.current_ptbr: Os ventos do oeste os levariam ao oeste; as chuvas do leste, ao leste. Mesmo que seu corpo apodrecesse, ele a protegeria. A confiança entre ambos traria ao mundo uma brisa de cura.'

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: エル・エレミア伝承を信奉する教会のみならず、この世界の絶対的なシンボルとも言えるものである。
dialogues.original_en: This describes the need for a Reyvateil to have a knight as a partner in order to bring out her true powers. Not just the Elemia Church, but this whole world sees this as a global symbol.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Representa a necessidade de um cavaleiro parceiro para despertar o poder da Reyvateil. É símbolo de todo o mundo, não só da Igreja.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: ナビテ・カプ
dialogues.original_en: Nabite Cap
dialogues.current_ptbr: Tampa Nabite

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: テル族に伝わるロスト・テクノロジーの1つ。導力エネルギーを大量に蓄えることが出来る。グラスメルクで作れるパワーソーサーやボルタポルタも同じような役割を持つが、その蓄導力は1000倍では済まない程に強い。
dialogues.original_en: One of the lost technologies of the Teru Tribe. It can store a large amount of Symphonic Energy. The Power Sourcer and Boltapolta that is made by Grathmelding is similar to this, but it can store more than 1000 times the amount.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Tecnologia perdida dos Teru que armazena enorme energia sinfônica: mais de mil vezes a capacidade do Power Sourcer e de Boltapolta feitos por Grathmelding.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: テル族の掟に従い、フラウトは今まで封印してきていたが、世界全体が一つになるという想いを受け、ナビテ・カプの封印を解き作ることを決意した。
dialogues.original_en: Under the law of the Teru Tribe, Flute had kept it sealed, but feeling that the whole world would come together made him decide to release the seal and create this item.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Flute a mantinha selada por lei dos Teru. Ao sentir que o mundo se uniria, decidiu romper o selo e criar o item.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: FFTディバイダ
dialogues.original_en: FFT Divider
dialogues.current_ptbr: Divisor FFT

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: 1つの素体に2つの異なる意識が入り込んでいる場合(わかりやすく言えば憑依されている場合)、その意識を分離させる事が出来るアイテム。FFTとは、人間やレーヴァ
dialogues.original_en: When two different minds come into one body (when one is possessed), this item can separate these consciousnesses.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Separa duas consciências que ocupam o mesmo corpo, como numa possessão.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: テイルが持つ固有の波動『FFTスペクトラム』を指す。そのスペクトラムを分解し、身体の遺伝子と合わない方を排除するという役割を持つ。
dialogues.original_en: FFT refers to the ”FFT Spectrum” which is a unique wave that is different in each individual Human and Reyvateil. It analyzes this spectrum and rids of the consciousness that does not match the DNA of the body.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Analisa o Espectro FFT, único para cada humano e Reyvateil, e remove a consciência que não corresponde ao DNA do corpo.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: オリジン
dialogues.original_en: Origin
dialogues.current_ptbr: Origem

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: レーヴァテイル・オリジンと言われている、レーヴァテイルの中でも最も強力な種。全世界に3体しかいないと言われている。そしてその1体がシュレリアである。オリジンは、無限の生命力がある。その源は塔、アルトネリコである。
dialogues.original_en: Called the Reyvateil Origins, they are the most powerful of all Reyvateil. Only three exist in this whole world, of which one is Shurelia. Origins have an unlimited life energy, the source being the Tower, Ar Tonelico.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Reyvateils Originais, as mais poderosas. Só existem três, incluindo Shurelia. Recebem energia vital ilimitada da Torre Ar Tonelico.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: 元々レーヴァテイルという種は、塔と同調し、塔そのものとなるべく作られた、人間型の塔インターフェイスなのである。それ故、オリジンは自分の魂である塔が沈黙しない限り、朽ちることはないのだ。
dialogues.original_en: Originally, Reyvateils were made to synchronize with the Tower and become the Tower itself. They are the Tower with an interface of humans. Therefore, Origins will never die until their souls, the Tower, ceases to function.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Foram criadas para se sincronizar e ser a própria Torre, com interface humana. Vivem enquanto sua alma, a Torre, funcionar.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: 基本性能は、他のレーヴァテイルとは比較にならないほど強い。塔とのコンタクトがとれるため、いつでも塔の力を引き出すことが出来る。故に、ガーディアンを呼び出したり、情報プログラムを具現化させることも容易い。
dialogues.original_en: Their standard abilities are much stronger than other Reyvateils. Since they keep in contact with the Tower, they are always able to use its power. Therefore, it’s easy for them to call guardians and give programs a physical form.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Seu poder supera o das demais. A conexão constante permite usar a energia da Torre para invocar guardiões e materializar programas facilmente.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: また、全てのレーヴァテイルに遺伝子を分け与えている、クローンマスターでもある。オリカやミシャは、シュレリアの血を受け継いでいる。
dialogues.original_en: Origins are also the clone master of all Reyvateils. Aurica and Misha both carry the blood of Shurelia.
dialogues.current_ptbr: As Originais também são matrizes dos clones. Aurica e Misha descendem de Shurelia.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: アーデルベルグ緩衝帯
dialogues.original_en: Ardelberg Buffer Zone
dialogues.current_ptbr: Zona-tampão Ardelberg

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: 純度100%のアーデル結晶という素材で作られた、正八面体のクリスタル。その役割は、強大な導力の逆流を防ぐ事である。半導体と同じで、導力を片方向にしか流さないのだ。
dialogues.original_en: A octahedral crystal that is made from a 100% pure Ardel Crystal. Its purpose is to prevent the blackflow of Symphonic Power. Like a semiconductor, it only allows Symphonic Power to flow in one direction.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Cristal octaédrico de Ardel puro. Como um semicondutor, deixa a energia sinfônica passar num único sentido e impede o refluxo.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: 太古の昔、塔がまだ生きていた頃、魔法の力は塔の上側、現在のブラストラインにあった4枚のグラスノ盤から放出されていた。
dialogues.original_en: Long ago in ancient times when the Tower was still alive, magic powers radiated from above the Tower, from four Grathnode Discs where the current Blastline exists.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Na antiguidade, quatro Discos Grathnode emitiam poder acima da Torre, onde hoje fica a Blastline.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: その導力はあまりに強大で、万一それが逆流し下に戻ってしまうと大変な被害となる。その為、導力の流れが一方通行となるアーデル結晶を用い、逆流を防いでいたのだ。何かを生み出しているわけではないが、この塔の命綱として最高に大切な施設である。
dialogues.original_en: Its power was so strong, that had it flowed back down, it would cause a tremendous disaster. This is why the one-way Ardel Crystal is used to prevent that backflow. It may not create anything, but it is serves as a very important safety facility.
dialogues.current_ptbr: O retorno dessa energia causaria desastre. O Cristal Ardel impede o refluxo. Não produz nada, mas é um dispositivo essencial de segurança.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: 導力プラグ
dialogues.original_en: Symphonic Reactor
dialogues.current_ptbr: Reator sinfônico

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: 第三紀で「使徒の祭壇」と呼ばれている場所の正式名称。本来は、塔の大動脈であり、地上からグラスノ盤へ駆け抜けるメイン導力ラインの終着点。
dialogues.original_en: The standard name for the place people of the third era call the ”Altar of Apostles.” It is the end of the main Symphonic Power line from the surface of land that shoots out to the Grathnode Disc.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Nome técnico do Altar dos Apóstolos: extremidade da linha principal de energia sinfônica que liga o solo ao Disco Grathnode.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: 要するに、導力プラグという場所はLANケーブルのコネクタであり、そこは塔の超高速回線がむき出しになっている場所なのである。
dialogues.original_en: In other words, the place called Symphonic Reactor is a connector for a LAN cable, and is where the super speed network is revealed.
dialogues.current_ptbr: É como um conector de cabo de rede, onde se expõe a conexão de altíssima velocidade.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: ウイルスが決まってここから出てくるのは、莫大なデータ量となるウイルスの具現化情報を高速に転送して、フリップフロップ変換をさせる事が可能な為である。
dialogues.original_en: The reason why viruses appear from this place is because it can send out the physical transformation information through the vast data and make it possible for flip-flop conversion.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Vírus surgem ali porque o fluxo de dados permite enviar informações de materialização e realizar conversão flip-flop.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: MULEプロジェクト
dialogues.original_en: Mir Project
dialogues.current_ptbr: Projeto Mir

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: 天覇に在籍していたボルドが進めていた計画。レーヴァテイルから自由意志を剥奪し、邪念を無くすことで詩魔法の精度を上げる、そして従順な兵士とする為の計画。最初にこれを行ったのは第二紀の末期である。
dialogues.original_en: A project that Bourd had secretly been working on in Tenba. He was planning to take away free will from Reyvateils, getting rid of all desires, to make them obedient soldiers. This project was first performed during the end of the Second Era.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Projeto secreto de Bourd na Tenba para retirar vontade e desejos das Reyvateils e torná-las soldados obedientes. Foi executado pela primeira vez no fim da Segunda Era.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: ボルドは塔の中を探索している最中に、偶然これに関する資料を見つけてしまったのだ。
dialogues.original_en: Bourd had coincidently found data on this project while searching throught the Tower.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Bourd encontrou seus dados por acaso ao pesquisar a Torre.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: 飛空挺『グングニル』
dialogues.original_en: Airship ”Gungnir”
dialogues.current_ptbr: Nave “Gungnir”

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: エレミアの使徒、ホルスの民、テル族、レーヴァテイル。全ての種族の技術力や力を集結させて完成した飛空挺。その性能たるや、今までの何よりも優れており、不可能だった
dialogues.original_en: Apostles of Elemia, people of Horus, the Teru Tribe, and Reyvateil. All the people and all their skills and power came together to complete this airship.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Apóstolos, povo de Horus, Teru e Reyvateils uniram habilidades e poderes para concluir esta aeronave.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: ブラストライン越えも難なくこなせる。天覇社長、亜耶乃はこの飛空挺を「世界の宝」と言った。
dialogues.original_en: Its abilities are far superior to any other airship and crossing the Blastline, which was thought to be impossible, could easily be done. Ayano, the president of Tenba, called this ship a treasure of the world.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Supera qualquer outra e cruza facilmente a Blastline, antes considerada intransponível. Ayano a chamou de tesouro do mundo.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: プラズマベル
dialogues.original_en: Plasma Bell
dialogues.current_ptbr: Sino de plasma

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: 重力場不安定装置。ホルスの翼が浮いているのは、これのおかげである。ベルから半径30000ストンくらいを守備範囲とし、その範囲の重力場を制御する。
dialogues.original_en: Gravitational Field Unstabilizing System. Wings of Horus can stay float because of this. It covers a radius of about 30,000 stons from the Bell, in which it can control the gravitational field in this area.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Sistema desestabilizador de gravidade que mantém as Asas de Horus flutuando. Controla o campo num raio de cerca de 30.000 stons do Sino.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: 昔は2つ存在したが、第二紀に片方が割れ、ホルスの翼は半分になった。CRプラズマベルは、この世界の人々の命を支える重要な施設である。故に、ここには特殊なガーディアンがいる。それがメイメイの亜種である
dialogues.original_en: There were two of these in the past, but during the second era, one of them had broken, and Horus had split in half. The Plasma Bell is an important facility that supports the lives of many people in this world. Therefore, special guardians exist here.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Havia dois, mas um quebrou na Segunda Era e Horus se dividiu. O Sino de Plasma sustenta muitas vidas e tem guardiões especiais.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: 「カナデ」と「マイ」である。彼女たちは戦巫女の姿をしていて、この世界有数の超強力戦闘兵器として存在している。
dialogues.original_en: Much like a subspecies of Meimei, they are Kanade and Mai. They are dressed in Battle Maiden (Miko) outfits, and exist as one of the strongest battle weapons in this world.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Kanade e Mai, semelhantes a Mei Mei, vestem trajes de sacerdotisa guerreira e estão entre as armas mais fortes do mundo.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: メンテナンスロイド
dialogues.original_en: Maintenance Droid
dialogues.current_ptbr: Droide manutenção

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: 第一紀に作られた、塔内で作業をするための汎用型ロボット。現在稼働が確認されているのは、セキュリティプロトコル・メイメイと、プラズマベルガーディアン・カナデ
dialogues.original_en: A multipurpose robot made during the first era to take care of the Tower. The only ones that are confirmed to be currently active are Security Protocol Meimei, and Plasma Bell Guardian Kanade.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Robô multiuso da Primeira Era para cuidar da Torre. Só Mei Mei, de segurança, e Kanade, do Sino de Plasma, estão confirmadas como ativas.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: のみである。それぞれ役割は違えど、塔の中を整備守護する役割として作られており、その任務を忠実にこなす。
dialogues.original_en: Although their tasks are different, they are meant to organize and protect the Tower, and are very loyal to their duties.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Apesar das funções diferentes, organizam e protegem a Torre com grande lealdade.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: 神の咆吼
dialogues.original_en: Roar of the Gods
dialogues.current_ptbr: Rugido dos Deuses

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: 「導力エネルギー」の事。テル族は導力とは言わず、神の咆吼と言う。
dialogues.original_en: Another name for Symphonic Energy. The Teru Tribe calls it the Roar of the Gods instead.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Nome que os Teru dão à Energia Sinfônica.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: ELMA
dialogues.original_en: ELMA
dialogues.current_ptbr: ELMA

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: シュレリアのガーディアンとして存在しているメカ動物。フリップフロップ変換を自在に行えるため、シュレリアが呼べばどこでも具現化出来る。実は甘えん坊。
dialogues.original_en: Shurelia’s mech-animal who serves as her guardian. It can use flip-flop conversion, so it will appear anywhere if Shurelia calls. Actually very attention needy.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Animal mecânico de Shurelia que a protege. Usa conversão flip-flop para aparecer onde ela chamar. Na verdade, quer muita atenção.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: けが知っていた謎の食材。スクワート地方に生息する植物であることはわかっているが、現在スクワート村の生き残りは殆どいないため、この植物自体の存在が謎に包まれつつある。
